title: Lana Nusseibeh’s U.N. Bid Collides With U.A.E.’s Role in Sudan
summary_full: Lana Nusseibeh, one of the Gulf nation’s top diplomats, has led the effort to deny her country’s role in Sudan. Now it’s complicating her bid to become secretary general of the United Nations.
